description: KL321. Names and types against the catalog: the game silently ignores what its VFX doesn't have. Errors where Kiln.Blocks refuses them: a cast, a projectile, a status, a VFX block of the mod.

diagnostics.message: Explosion_Fixture_Frost has no parameter "radus", and the game ignores what it doesn't have; it has radius, color, targetPosition, count, enabled and 1 without a known name; did you mean "radius"?
"radius" of Explosion_Fixture_Frost is a float, and this is a color: the game ignores it; write it as a number
"count" of Explosion_Fixture_Frost is an int, and this is a float: the game ignores it; write it as {"int": n}
"enabled" of Explosion_Fixture_Frost is a bool, and this is a float: the game ignores it; a block can't set bool
Sequence_Fixture_Charge has no parameter "radius", and the game ignores what it doesn't have; it has no named ones
"spark" is a VFX block, which has no named parameters yet (Kiln.Blocks refuses it). Only a game VFX takes them
a status cannot set a VFX's parameters: the game's data takes a block laid out by the VFX, which only clients have (Kiln.Blocks refuses it). Put the VFX on an effect, or leave them out
a spell's cast cannot set a VFX's parameters: the game's data takes a block laid out by the VFX, which only clients have (Kiln.Blocks refuses it). Put the VFX on an effect, or leave them out
a projectile cannot set a VFX's parameters: the game's data takes a block laid out by the VFX, which only clients have (Kiln.Blocks refuses it). Put the VFX on an effect, or leave them out
